intro: Earlier work, from the landscapes and aerial views of the London and Norfolk years to the first invented pictures.

series.title: Aerial views
series.intro: For many years Richard made a speciality of aerial views, mostly of great houses, for the National Trust and private owners. Examples are in the collections of the Victoria and Albert Museum and the National Trust.

series.title: Landscape and still life
series.intro: For around 25 years, living in London and Norfolk, Richard worked mainly as a painter of landscape and still life, with a few portraits.

series.title: Watercolours
series.intro: Richard was elected to the Royal Watercolour Society in 1975 and was its President from 2006 to 2009.
